title: On the non-existence of a left-symmetric structure on osp(1|2) in any characteristic
summary: Burde proved that the Lie algebra $\mathfrak{sl}_2(\mathbb{K})$, over a field $\mathbb{K}$ of characteristic $p > 2$, admits compatible left-symmetric algebra structures if and only if $p = 3$. Since the even part of the Lie superalgebra $\mathfrak{osp}(1|2)$ is isomorphic to $\mathfrak{sl}_2(\mathbb{K})$, we ask whether Burde's structures can be extended to compatible left-symmetric superalgebra structures on $\mathfrak{osp}(1|2)$.
